kind: M7 child tool-projection shape reference (child-tools-shape.json): what the v2 subagent's first /v1/responses request must and must not carry in its tool surface.
status: Reference shape for coordinator cross-reference. The SCORED spot-checks live in MXAI-C07 (last:0 pins on the child's first request: mirror-present, v2-collab-kept, v1-collab-dropped, child_ran control) — this fixture is the expected shape, not a scored artifact.
mechanism: child_safe_tool_specs (xai-grok-shell session/acp_session_impl/child_tool_projection.rs): BOTH the Rebuilt and VerbatimMirror children drop the v1 root-only active-message tool (matched by the ActiveAgentMessage kind, with a canonical-name catch for the case where the child bridge no longer registers the tool). The five v2 collaboration tools ride the same ActiveAgentMessage kind on purpose and are EXEMPT — v2 siblings message each other through the mailbox, and their wire names are pinned by the v2 protocol, so the name exemption is stable. VerbatimMirror leaves every other field of the parent's ToolSpecs unchanged so the child's request still hits the parent's radix cache.
redaction: sweep-0: tool names + structural lists only; no creds/host paths/IPs/secret URLs.
